notes.title: We're Back!! Thanks for Waiting!
notes.content:
Wow... I can't even start to say what a tough few months it's been, but today marks our final return to Steam!  We've been working behind the scenes, trying to get the game back up, and it's a massive relief to us to finally be returning!

As well as becoming available on steam again, today we've released a new trailer for the game, as well as a sizeable patch, which includes bugfixes, gameplay improvements, and some sweet new music in the secret area (Find it if you can)!

Special thanks to P.R. for composing the remix of the main theme that you hear in the trailer!  If you haven't seen it yet, it's worth watching just for that!

I'll be keeping my eyes on the community pages e.t.c. to check out how everyone's getting on with this new update, so feel free to leave a message and I'll make sure I reply!

Happy playing
-Vethan

notes.title: Standpoint Patch Notes 28/05/15
notes.content:
Released a patch today. Includes some fixes and optimisations, but most importantly:

HOTFIX:
Bargaining 1 Puzzle ending puzzle still broken in conditions.  This has been hammered several times, and I hope this is the last I see of this problem.

Optimisations to the amount of particles displayed at one time.  Denial 3 should feel less chuggy on first boot.

notes.title: Time Trial update! And Thanks!
notes.content:
Firstly [b]Thank you so much for buying the game[/b].  We can't describe how much each and every one of you guys that's enjoying the game so far means to us.  We've been really quiet since release, but if you haven't noticed there have been a slew of tiny updates coming out, improving level areas, fixing bugs and just making things feel better.  From now on we'll try and release more comprehensive patch notes so you know what Standpoint keeps updating.
		
Today, however, we're releasing quite a significant feature change update.  Previously on the main menu you might have noticed there was a greyed out "????" option for time trials, which unlocked once you completed the game.  We've now made time trials available from the beginning of the game, simply letting you play up to the latest level you've reached!  Leaderboards were also suffering a bug on steam, due to how we were storing the time values. This is now fixed, so you can show off your runs!
		
Looking forward to seeing what you guys think!

notes.title: Impressions: Standpoint
notes.content:
First-person puzzlers are still a rare enough treat that it’s always worth perking up your ears when one comes along. While Standpoint – out on Steam today – is far more of a pure puzzler than the likes of Portal or the Talos Principle, it’s as smart as either. I’m not yet halfway through, because my flipping goodness, it’s hard. But here are my impressions so far.
